title: Swiftly
description: A smooth, optimized vanilla Minecraft experience with essential performance improvements.
body:
![Swiftly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36f494132fd3015e9961c027f4e57e68bbb1333e.png)

A **lightweight Fabric modpack** built for one purpose: **make Minecraft feel smooth** while staying **close to vanilla**.

Swiftly focuses on **high FPS, stable gameplay, and “Minecraft-should-have-this” quality-of-life** — without bloating your instance with unnecessary content mods.  
Perfect for **mid-range and low-end PCs**, and also great as a **clean base** for your own modpack.

---

## ✨ Why Swiftly?
### ✅ Fast & Smooth
- Major FPS improvements and reduced stutter
- Better chunk/tick performance for a more stable experience

### ✅ Vanilla-First
- No gameplay overhaul, no extra progression
- Keeps the vanilla look and feel — just better

### ✅ Shader-Ready
- Full shader support (Iris)
- Runs great both with and without shaders

### ✅ Lightweight & Compatible
- Minimal mod list, maximum impact
- Great as a starter pack for adding your own mods

---

## 🧩 Included Mods (Core)
**Performance / Rendering**
- Sodium
- Lithium
- Iris Shaders

**Quality-of-Life**
- AppleSkin
- Mouse Tweaks
- Zoomify
- Gamma Utils (Fullbright)
- Simple Voice Chat *(optional, multiplayer-ready)*

**Libraries (Required)**
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)

> The mod list may evolve over time, but the philosophy stays the same: **clean, fast, vanilla-friendly**.

---

## ⚙️ System Requirements
**Minimum (Playable / Vanilla+ Smooth)**
- **RAM:** 4 GB allocated
- **CPU/GPU:** any modern integrated graphics should work fine
- **Works best without shaders**

**Recommended (Smooth 1080p / Optional Shaders)**
- **RAM:** 6 GB allocated
- **Dedicated GPU recommended** for shaders

> Tip: If you play with shaders, start with a lightweight preset and adjust render distance for stable FPS.

---

![Instructions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f48569df9ca45c496a407f2d5355cb275690338a.png)

## 🛠️ Installation
1. Install **Fabric** for your Minecraft version
2. Download **Swiftly** from Modrinth
3. Import the pack into your launcher (Modrinth App / Prism / ATLauncher)
4. Allocate **4 GB RAM minimum** (**6 GB recommended**)
5. Launch and enjoy 🚀

---

## 🚀 Quick Optimization Tips
- Lower **Render Distance** if you get stutters (try **6–10**)
- Turn **Clouds OFF** for free FPS
- Keep **Particles** on “Decreased” for smoother fights
- If shaders are enabled: reduce **Shadow Quality** first

---

## 📌 Notes
- This pack is intentionally **minimal**.
- Suggestions are welcome — performance and stability always come first.

**Minecraft as it should feel: clean, fast, and smooth.**
